opportunities.description: [Request for Proposal] The City of Virginia Beach is dedicated to advancing organizational performance through the application of strategic planning, performance measurement, project and portfolio management, and informed, data-driven decision-making. In support of these objectives, the City is seeking a state-of-the-art, cloud-based Strategy and Performance Management (SPM) Software as a Service (SaaS) solution, offering a centralized platform to efficiently manage strategic initiatives, organizational goals, performance metrics, projects, and executive-level reporting.

opportunities.source_name: OpenGov — County of San Mateo, CA
opportunities.title: Facility Condition Assessment and Asset Management Solution
opportunities.description: The County of San Mateo (County) is soliciting competitive proposals from qualified firms to deliver a turnkey Facility Condition Assessment (FCA), compile a unified Master Equipment Register (MER), deploy an enterprise-grade cloud Facility Condition Information System (FCIS), and implement bi-directional integration with the County’s Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) IBM Maximo Application Suite SaaS. This solicitation is structured into two distinct operational phases: PHASE 1 (BASE SCOPE) : Complete on-site baseline Facility Condition Assessments across approximately 100 facilities (~4.5 million gross square feet across 75 sites) following ASTM E2018-24 standards. Perform discrete equipment nameplate inventories and install durable 2D physical barcode tags for maintainable mechanical, electrical, plumbing, conveyance, and life-safety systems. Compile and validate a unified Master Equipment Register (MER) that establishes an identical data baseline between IBM Maximo and the FCIS. Provide, configure, and host a SaaS-based FCIS platform delivering real-time Facility Condition Index (FCI) calculations, multi-year capital renewal modeling, and localized RSMeans-based cost estimating. Format, validate, and batch-load the complete Master Equipment Register directly into the County’s IBM Maximo Application Suite environment, and establish automated synchronization between Maximo and the FCIS. PHASE 2 (OPTIONAL/ADD-ALTERNATIVE SCOPE): Develop standard, manufacturer-aligned Preventive Maintenance (PM) Job Plans, task check-sheets, and recommended service frequencies, pre-formatted for direct batch upload into Maximo Job Plans and PM Master applications.

opportunities.description: The City of Lexington invites qualified firms to propose a cloud-hosted software solution for permitting, development review, plan review, zoning, inspections, code enforcement, payment processing, and related municipal development functions. All inquiries and questions about this RFP must be submitted in writing by email to Purchasing Officer, Britt Smith bssmith@lexingtonnc.gov Issuance of this Request for Proposals does not commit the City of Lexington to award a contract, to pay any costs incurred in preparation of a proposal or to procure or contract for related services or supplies. opportunities.description: The City of Pasadena Water and Power Department (“PWP”) is seeking proposals from qualified and experienced firms to provide wood pole inspection, repair, restoration, treatment, and related reporting services for PWP’s electric distribution system. The selected firm will support PWP’s ongoing maintenance and compliance program for wood poles, including visual inspections, intrusive inspections, groundline inspections, preservative treatments, minor corrective repairs, pole reinforcement recommendations, installation of approved repair materials, and detailed reporting of observed conditions. PWP’s wood pole program is intended to support safe, reliable, and compliant operation of the electric distribution system in accordance with applicable requirements, including California Public Utilities Commission (“CPUC”) General Order 95, Rules for Overhead Electric Line Construction, and CPUC General Order 165, Inspection Requirements for Electric Distribution and Transmission Facilities. PWP’s system includes approximately 11,000 wood poles, including both municipally owned and jointly owned poles. A significant portion of the pole population is located in rear property or otherwise constrained access locations. The scope of services may include, but is not limited to, pole condition assessment, identification of structural damage or decay, inspection for General Order 95 infractions, groundline and below-ground inspections, preservative and fumigant treatment, installation of visibility strips, guy guards, ground molding, pole tags, and steel truss reinforcement where approved by PWP. The selected firm shall also provide detailed inspection records, photographs, condition ratings, repair recommendations, and electronic data deliverables in a format acceptable to PWP. In addition to conventional field inspection and treatment services, PWP intends to include drone or other unmanned aerial vehicle (“UAV”) inspection services under the resulting contract. UAV services may be used to supplement field inspections, improve access to difficult or hazardous locations, document pole-top conditions, capture high-resolution imagery, and support more efficient assessment of pole attachments, crossarms, hardware, conductors, insulators, and other visible overhead facilities. UAV services shall be performed by qualified, FAA-compliant personnel and in accordance with all applicable federal, state, and local requirements. The selected firm shall furnish all supervision, labor, materials, equipment, vehicles, tools, technology, software, transportation, permits, methods, processes, and incidentals necessary to complete the work in accordance with the final scope of services, applicable laws and regulations, industry standards, and PWP requirements.

opportunities.title: Rental Registry Database and Portal
opportunities.description: The City of Pasadena Rent Stabilization Department is seeking proposals from qualified vendors to provide a comprehensive rental registry database and online portal. The selected vendor will be responsible to meet the City's need for implementing, operating, and maintaining a system that supports the requirements of City Charter Article XVIII, which governs rent stabilization in Pasadena. The Department requires a fully hosted online platform that enables landlords to register rental units, update unit and tenancy information, apply for exemptions, and pay the City’s annual rental registry fee, including any applicable late fees. The system must also allow landlords to submit any rent registration-related notices or documents mandated by the Charter or any applicable federal, state, or local laws directly to the City through the registry portal. A Rental Registry is a core, foundational tool to monitor compliance with Charter Article XVIII to ensure that rent adjustments are in compliance with local law. There are approximately 26,000+ rental units registered within the City of Pasadena Rent Stabilization Department's Rental Registry. Rental property owners are required to register on annual basis and pay a registration fee for each rental unit. Exemptions for the annual registration fee are available and processed through the Rental Registry. Outside of the annual rental registration window from September-October, rental property owners are required to utilize the system to record key events including, but not limited to, occupancy amendments, rent increases and transfer of ownerships. The Rent Stabilization launched its Rental Registry on September 2024. It contains data for approximately 26,000+ rental units. Online payments can be made via eCheck and through Payroc via debit/credit card. A key desire for the next system is to integrate with Tyler Cashiering. City Charter Article XVIII can be accessed via this link: https://library.municode.com/ca/pasadena/codes/code_of_ordinances?nodeId=CH_ARTXVIIIPAFAEQHOCHAM . Adopted regulations concerning rental registration, Chapter 9, are available on the Pasadena Rent Stabilization Website via this link: https://www.cityofpasadena.net/rent-stabilization/notices-forms-resources/#regulations

Schneider discontinued the Galaxy 5000 line in July 2021, so parts and service support are limited. Therefore, ARC is requesting proposals to furnish, deliver, install, and commission one three-phase Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) to replace its existing unit, with the work complete by December 31, 2026.
